title: Concept: MD5 use via Digest::MD5.hexdigest (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, Digest::MD5.hexdigest computes MD5. Collision attacks let an attacker forge a second input with the same digest, which defeats signatures and integrity checks while leaving non-security checksums unaffected. The ruby-specific remedy is Digest::SHA256.hexdigest.
applicability: ruby codebases hashing data through Digest::MD5.hexdigest; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged integrity values and signatures when MD5 protects untrusted data; LOW severity as a default because checksum uses dominate, raised on review when the digest is security-relevant.
